def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # EXTENDED CONTRACT. Time model: busiest-SM compute path, L2->SM feed and DRAM feed overlap as a p=2 norm.
    # kappa (L2 feed price) fixed at its physical bound 1.0 (every DRAM byte passes through L2; sat there in all 20 I3c fits).
    # The raster deficit enters the DRAM leg: tm_dram_ratio * 2^l2_locality_deficit is this raster's own DRAM time.
    d = f.tm_dram_ratio * np.power(2.0, f.l2_locality_deficit)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(f.tm_crit_ratio) + np.square(f.tm_l2_ratio) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Efficiency the norm cannot see: register-staged 2-stage mainloop, CTA-wide barrier over more warps.
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_barrier_domain
    # Split-K time model with an interior optimum (fill/epilogue per round, serial fix-up at DRAM). It is a log2 time
    # factor like the norm's 10*log2(t), so its consistent weight is the norm's scale, 10 (physics-fixed, not fitted).
    s = s + 10.0 * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    # Latency path of the busiest SM (J4b, copied exactly). Little's law: its CTAs stream n*ceil(K/(tk*sk)) k-steps while
    # only min(n, blocks/SM)*(stages-1) k-step loads are in flight -> 2^splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log serial round trips;
    # each serial split-K slice after the first adds 2 more (wait on the predecessor's partial: read, then write);
    # serial_reduction_dependency * mainloop_iteration_count = split_k - 1 for serial mode, 0 otherwise.
    # L = 1 us loaded memory latency (fixed prior, J4b). t0 = 2MNK/peak is the unit of tm_crit_ratio, so lat/crit is the
    # latency path over the compute path. It is a log2 time factor, so its weight is the norm's scale 10 (fixed, not fitted).
    t0 = 2.0 * p.M * p.N * p.K / (hw.peak_tflops_f16 * 1e12)
    rounds = np.power(2.0, f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log) + 2.0 * f.serial_reduction_dependency * f.mainloop_iteration_count
    lat = rounds * 1e-6 / t0
    s = s + 10.0 * np.log2(np.maximum(1.0, lat / f.tm_crit_ratio))
    # Pure tie-break among raster variants that differ only in inst_total (I2b/J3b): sign fixed by physics (raster along
    # the shorter grid side: M>N -> +1, else -1), scale fixed at the 1e-3 prior per log2(inst) (<< one score unit), not fitted.
    if p.M > p.N:
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        sgn = -1.0
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s
